name: special-purpose-field-is-read-over
source: EUROCONTROL-SPEC-0149-9 Edition 1.21, I062/RE and I062/SP: explicit-length items whose first octet is the length of the item, itself included
reference: FSPEC 9b 0d 11 01 02 sets FRN 35 (octet 5, bit 7); the SP item is its length octet 03, which counts itself, and two octets. LEN 0x24 = 36. The items of vector 01 decode unchanged and encode writes vector 01's block: SP is not written.
